description: The openENTRANCE repository publishes shared variables, regional definitions and units for linking European low-carbon transition models. The consortium README explains that consistent nomenclature is needed to exchange scenario outputs across its integrated modelling work. Users select controlled names and region codes when preparing or comparing energy pathways; the output is a harmonised scenario schema, not numerical simulation results. Geographic coverage is chiefly Europe, with the particular regions defined in the published lists. The repository states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that a shared label does not guarantee two models have the same system boundary, technology representation or time resolution. Model-to-model transformations and scenario evidence still need checking. These definitions can support comparison or coupling of electricity, heat and transport-transition runs. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is an optimisation engine, not this naming standard. No scenario files or model packages were downloaded.
name: openENTRANCE energy-modelling nomenclature
